sources.title: Elden Ring Review (PS5)
sources.author: Liam Croft
sources.identity_evidence: The review page identifies Elden Ring, FromSoftware, Bandai Namco and the February 2022 PS5 release.
praise: Open-world exploration preserves FromSoftware's sense of danger and discovery.
The Dark Souls combat structure translates effectively to a much larger world.
criticism: The review notes some disappointments beneath the otherwise exceptional open-world adaptation.
evidence_points: The review discusses Limgrave, open-ended exploration, FromSoftware's difficulty and the move from earlier more linear level structures to the Lands Between.
